active_learning_additions.replicate_contract: EnsembleSurrogate.predict_replicates: row-wise (n_points, n_replicates>=2), stable replicate columns across calls
active_learning_additions.new_history_field: LearningStep.bootstrap_probability_band: optional immutable pair of actual replicate Pf extremes on fixed IID normal enrichment
active_learning_additions.default_change: FBR defaults to BootstrapBounds; existing U/EFF defaults unchanged
active_learning_additions.restrictions: BootstrapBounds requires an EnsembleSurrogate and fixed IID normal enrichment; spherical Student-t coordinates remain unsupported.

baseline_context: Integrated v2 development source, including feature PRs that remain unmerged in 1.x. Old names describe this numerical/refactoring checkpoint, not necessarily a released 1.x API.

plotting_additions.contract: Functions return (figure, axes), accept existing axes, and do not run or refit analyses. Grid/slice true-model evaluations are explicit additional plotting cost; coordinates and diagnostic meanings are documented.
